OpsBot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT ALERT: High CPU + OOM kills observed on preproc-pool-2 (service: prompt-preproc). Pager triggered: pd.inc/PRPT-41 at 1793001234
Maya (eng-runtime): seeing a bunch of pods restarting on preproc-pool-2, kernel OOM in syslog. 10% error rate on /v1/prompt/prep right now.
Maya (eng-runtime): logs snippet: `OOM killer: Killed process 23456 (python) total-vm:1200000kB, anon-rss:600000kB`
Lena (eng-sre): confirmed node flaps in eu-west1 region, pods evicted with reason "OOMKilled". cpu usage per pod spiked to 800m -> 3000m for short bursts.
Sanjay (oncall): @Maya can you check whether this is the tokenization preprocessor or downstream decoder? quick grep on service logs?
Maya (eng-runtime): looks like preproc. The tokenizer worker threads spike whenever we get long prompts + many concurrent requests (thundering herd). Prefetch caching not hitting.
Ethan (ml-runtime): this matches the new prompt-normalizer: we added aggressive regex-style backtracking for cleaning. Might be pathological on certain customer inputs.
Maya (eng-runtime): adding a temporary rate limit on the public /prompt endpoint to slow ingress. Will patch ingress rule to 60 rps per IP.
Lena (eng-sre): I'll scale the preproc deployment down to 2 replicas to reduce churn and trigger more stable scheduling while we patch — doing a graceful drain on overloaded nodes.
Maya (eng-runtime): running command to apply rate limit (kubectl snippet):
```
kubectl -n redwood exec -it ingress-nginx-0 -- bash -c "apply-rate-limit --route /v1/prompt --per-ip 60"
```
Sanjay (oncall): I'm taking pager. Handoff now. Current customer-impact: ~12 tenants seeing >=50% increase in 5xx; ~1% of total traffic failing. I'm updating incident board.
CustomerOps: Customer ops notified top-10 impacted customers via templated message. No P0 escalations yet, but one CS case opened complaining about timeouts.
Maya (eng-runtime): I pushed a hotfix to the tokenizer to add a cheap pre-check that rejects extremely long unbounded regex patterns. Rolling restart on preproc pods (canary first).
Ethan (ml-runtime): flagged the problematic normalization rule; adding a unit test and will revert rule if we see failures in canary.
Lena (eng-sre): canary pod is stable for 2m, CPU back to baseline. evictions stopped on canary node. Scaling back up to 6 replicas gradually.
OpsBot: Deploybot: image redwood/preproc:hotfix-1793 rolled out to canary at 1793001450, promoted to 2/6 at 1793001540.
Maya (eng-runtime): error rate dropping to ~3% now. Still monitoring KV cache warmup.
Sanjay (oncall): I've acknowledged pager and set status -> mitigated. Continuing monitoring for 30m. Handing off to next oncall at 1793001654.
Sanjay (oncall): Handoff note: root cause likely thundering-herd on tokenizer backtrack in prompt-normalizer combined with cache cold-starts. Mitigations: ingress rate-limit, hotfix to tokenizer to short-circuit pathological regex, scaled replicas to stabilize scheduling. Followups: add safety limits in normalizer, add telemetry for regex backtracking duration, consider QoS changes for preproc pods.
Maya (eng-runtime): filing follow-up ticket PRPT-42 with repro payloads and suggested fixes.
CustomerOps: Sent post-mitigation update to impacted customers: ETA for full RCA 48 hours. :thumbsup:
